summary: Finished the final slice (ExplorerRoutingCharacterization) and verified the whole revision. The explorer tests now prove a workspace-owned file opens in its owning workspace's tab strip while the workspace view stays on screen (R1/R3), that an already-open path reuses its one tab (R4), and that the global view never lists a workspace-owned file (R5/A2). Also raised the wait for the lazily-loaded image preview in src/App.explorer.test.tsx to 5s so it no longer times out under full-suite parallel load. The rest of the revision (src/state/workspaceTabs.ts partition + per-workspace selection, the shared pane-less EditorSurface, the flat GlobalEditorView, editor tabs in TabStrip, App routing with deferred startup files and per-workspace editor selection) was already in place from earlier slices and was checked rather than rebuilt. Ran npm run lint, the focused Vitest suites, npm run build (CodeSurface remains its own lazy chunk) and the full npm test suite. Full suite: 746 passed; the only failures are the two version tests that already fail at HEAD (they expect 2.3.0 while package.json is 2.4.1 and both files are unmodified/out of scope); App.shortcuts and the image preview passed on their own after the full-suite parallel-load timeouts.

R4: opening the same path again reuses its one tab and still reports it
